name: Molecular target, recognition range and exact feature
description: Represent which substrate, ligand, ion, macromolecule, sequence site or chemical feature is recognized or acted upon, with bounded exclusions and productive versus nonproductive recognition.
claim_scope: The operation recipient at warranted resolution: molecule, carrier/polymer context, residue/nucleotide and atom, stereoisomer/anomer or tested panel.
distinctions: Protein-level activity versus exact residue, nucleotide, atom or stereochemical assignment.
Affinity for one target versus discrimination against alternatives.

example_structured_values.meaning: Finite examples of declared values/reference types, not a complete ontology, numerical credit scale, adopted scoring axis or claim of existing runtime compatibility.

not_established: No-detection in a panel is not universal exclusivity.
Km, competition IC50 and Kd are different measurements.
Protein substrate assignment does not establish every altered phosphosite.
Homolog contacts, ligand complexes and best hits alone do not establish native specificity.
boundary: This is what is selected. A01 is the operation, A05 the regulatory effect, and A08 native physiological significance. Exact modification sites are explicit here, not buried under a generic activity label.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record actual_observations and annotation_consequence; recorded inspection scope: Primary introduction, sequence results, substrate table and competition methods/results inspected through indexed full text. Historical organism name preserved explicitly.
evidence.observation: Only nine of 475 residues differ, yet the tested melamine/ammeline and halo-triazine profiles differ.
evidence.limit: Tested panel is bounded, not universal exclusivity.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record actual_observations and annotation_consequence; recorded inspection scope: Primary introduction, cloning methods and positional-assay results inspected through indexed sections; no new analysis performed.
evidence.observation: Coarse AdoMet-related prediction becomes a tRNA guanosine-46 N7 assignment through modification and G46A substrate contrasts.
evidence.limit: Positional-assay sections inspected; no new assay.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record actual_observations and annotation_consequence; recorded inspection scope: Primary PNAS abstract plus NAR substrate-preparation methods and Q34 comparison results inspected. No live tRNA or protein calculation.
evidence.observation: Both tRNA-Asp preparations bind but only Q34-containing tRNA is glutamylated, separating carrier, chemical feature and productive recognition.
evidence.limit: Matched-substrate NAR sections read; associated PNAS source was abstract-level.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record actual_observations and annotation_consequence; recorded inspection scope: 2012 comparative alignment and tRNA-analysis results plus 2017 substrate/adduct methods and discussion inspected through indexed primary text. No new enzyme experiments.
evidence.observation: Free and tRNA-bound preQ0 form adducts, but productive archaeosine synthesis uses the tRNA-bound substrate.
evidence.limit: Author experiments; no new chemistry or whole-family transfer.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record actual_observations and annotation_consequence; recorded inspection scope: Full primary main text retrieved; identification, gene-organization, methylation results and methods read. No independent prfA-neighborhood query, mutation, or assay.
evidence.observation: Related methyltransferases distinguish release-factor GGQ glutamine from L3 glutamine; chemistry does not supply protein/site specificity.
evidence.limit: Identification/methylation sections read; no new assay.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record actual_observations and annotation_consequence; recorded inspection scope: 2008 primary abstract inspected; 2021 relevant complete YihS results, comparisons and figure legends inspected. Supporting spectra/kinetic fits not independently reprocessed.
evidence.observation: Sulfosugar preference, synthetic-reference/NMR product assignment and beta-SQ preference refine target and stereochemical resolution.
evidence.limit: 2021 relevant body inspected; 2008 ordinary-sugar work was abstract-level; spectra/fits not reprocessed.

evidence.source_locator: Tables 2–3; Figures 4–5; Online Methods and Discussion.
evidence.observation: E43A approximately preserves hya affinity but expands type-1 recognition, distinguishing one-target affinity from specificity.
evidence.limit: Clusterless structures do not directly show the proposed holo conformational trajectory.

evidence.source_locator: Trace route_2_phosphorylation_to_direct_contribution; main Tables 2–3; selected supplementary AceA site rows and assay Methods.
evidence.observation: The YeaG/AceA purified-protein assay supports phosphorylation with malate; site-resolved records do not establish the exact in-vitro modified sites.
evidence.limit: Actual research extracted selected XLSX rows/response contrasts; no raw spectra, native flux or exact assay site mapping.
